J2.evidence: «بِنُونٍ مُشَدَّدَةٍ مَكْسُورَةٍ أَوْ مَفْتُوحَةٍ يَلِيهَا نُونٌ مَكْسُورَةٌ»: مفتوحة qualifies the same نون مشددة, so the second reading is a doubled nūn with fatḥa followed by a nūn with kasra (لَيَأْتِيَنَّنِي). TR inserts an unmarked '(şeddesiz)' (without shadda), which contradicts the Arabic. Fix: remove '(şeddesiz)' (the fatha nūn is also şeddeli).

J1.evidence: Arabic: بِنُونٍ مُشَدَّدَةٍ مَكْسُورَةٍ أَوْ مَفْتُوحَةٍ يَلِيهَا نُونٌ مَكْسُورَةٌ - مفتوحة is coordinated with مكسورة as a description of the same doubled nūn (Ibn Kathīr's لَيَأْتِيَنَّنِي: doubled nūn with fatḥa, then nūn with kasra). TR inserts unmarked '(şeddesiz)' making the fatḥa nūn undoubled - wrong meaning and unmarked addition. EN 'or [a nūn] with fatḥa' is acceptable by comparison.

tr.fixed_note: Removed unmarked '(şeddesiz)'; the fatha nûn is now rendered as şeddeli per مُشَدَّدَةٍ مَكْسُورَةٍ أَوْ مَفْتُوحَةٍ
tr.verify_note: Unmarked (şeddesiz) removed; second reading now correctly a doubled nūn with fatḥa followed by a nūn with kasra; rest faithful.
